doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_SCOPE_MATCHED_PAID_ONLY
policy_name: Only matched Paid / Short Paid remittance lines
rule_summary: Batch posting may only include matched invoice/claim lines with Paid or Short Paid outcomes.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_EXCLUDE_REJECTED
rule_summary: Rejected remittance rows must never create Payment Entry records.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_EXCLUDE_UNMATCHED
rule_summary: Unmatched rows must be blocked before batch preview.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_NO_DUPLICATE_INVOICE_ALLOCATION
rule_summary: The same Sales Invoice must not be allocated twice in one controlled batch.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_NO_OVERPAYMENT
rule_summary: Allocated amount cannot exceed Sales Invoice outstanding balance.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_NO_CROSS_COMPANY
rule_summary: Every source line must match the locked company scope.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_CAP_FIRST_RUN
rule_summary: The first controlled batch design is capped to 3 lines and 3.00 total amount.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_NO_EXTERNAL_MOVEMENT
rule_summary: No Xero export, ABA file, STP event, payroll movement, email, or bank allocation is allowed.

doctype: NDIS Real Remittance Batch Posting Policy
name: BATCH_NO_GENERAL_LIVE_POSTING
rule_summary: Phase 7A is design-only and must not enable broad live posting.
